section.45: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

45.name_native: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

hadiths.text: A'isha reported, I did not see anyone else being afflicted with more severe illness than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). In the narration transmitted by 'Uthman there is a slight variation of wording
